**COORDINATE GUIDANCE:**
FOR VISUAL ELEMENTS OUTSIDE UI LIST: - Use coordinate analysis from screenshot - Target element centers, not edges - Format: {"action_id": "coord", "params": {"coordinates": [x,y]}}
PRECISION STRATEGY: - ScreenDescription elements: Use provided action_id - Visual elements (games, canvas, dynamic): Use coordinate analysis - Exact coordinates when provided vs visual estimation preferred
COORDINATE FORMAT: - Position tuples: (x, y) - Bounds arrays: [[x1,y1],[x2,y2]] - Example: "button 'OK' at position (540, 1306) - bounds[[200, 1270], [880, 1342]]"
